Pure, typed, verified. No null, exceptions, loops, mutation, classes. Names: `lowerCamel` values, `UpperCamel` types. 2-space indent, no `;`.

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`
```
type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)
type Pos = Int where it > 0
```

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```
Generic: `fn first[T](xs: List[T]) -> Option[T]`.

## Expressions
- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`
There are no loops. Before writing recursion over a list, use these methods: `xs.map(f)`, `xs.filter(f)`, `xs.sum()`, `xs.count(f)`, `xs.fold(init, f)`. A method call needs no `decreases`.
- Int `abs min max clamp pow isEven isOdd toStr toFloat` · Float `sqrt floor ceil round abs min max toStr`
- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`
- Time: an app may define `fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]]`; `Sub.every(ms, msg)` (ms >= 50) sends `msg` every `ms` milliseconds while it is listed; `Sub.clock(ms, f)` (ms >= 1000) sends `f(seconds since 1970)`; `Sub.online(f)`/`Sub.visible(f)` send `f(Bool)`.

## Types

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```

- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`

- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`

  Rect(w, h) => w * h

  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi

# Tez in one page
Pure, typed, verified. No null, exceptions, loops, mutation, classes. Names: `lowerCamel` values, `UpperCamel` types. 2-space indent, no `;`.

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`
```
type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)
type Pos = Int where it > 0
```

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```
Generic: `fn first[T](xs: List[T]) -> Option[T]`.

## Expressions
- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`
There are no loops. Before writing recursion over a list, use these methods: `xs.map(f)`, `xs.filter(f)`, `xs.sum()`, `xs.count(f)`, `xs.fold(init, f)`. A method call needs no `decreases`.
- Int `abs min max clamp pow isEven isOdd toStr toFloat` · Float `sqrt floor ceil round abs min max toStr`
- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`

fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```

- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`
There are no loops. Before writing recursion over a list, use these methods: `xs.map(f)`, `xs.filter(f)`, `xs.sum()`, `xs.count(f)`, `xs.fold(init, f)`. A method call needs no `decreases`.
- Int `abs min max clamp pow isEven isOdd toStr toFloat` · Float `sqrt floor ceil round abs min max toStr`
- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`
- Time: an app may define `fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]]`; `Sub.every(ms, msg)` (ms >= 50) sends `msg` every `ms` milliseconds while it is listed; `Sub.clock(ms, f)` (ms >= 1000) sends `f(seconds since 1970)`; `Sub.online(f)`/`Sub.visible(f)` send `f(Bool)`.
- UI view: `Html[Msg]` built with `Html.text(s)` `Html.heading(s)` `Html.paragraph(s)` `Html.button(label, msg)` `Html.input(value, f)` `Html.row(kids)` `Html.col(kids)` `Html.node(tag, attrs, kids)`

  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0 }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),

# Tez in one page
Pure, typed, verified. No null, exceptions, loops, mutation, classes. Names: `lowerCamel` values, `UpperCamel` types. 2-space indent, no `;`.

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`
```
type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)
type Pos = Int where it > 0
```

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```
Generic: `fn first[T](xs: List[T]) -> Option[T]`.

## Expressions
- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`
There are no loops. Before writing recursion over a list, use these methods: `xs.map(f)`, `xs.filter(f)`, `xs.sum()`, `xs.count(f)`, `xs.fold(init, f)`. A method call needs no `decreases`.
- Int `abs min max clamp pow isEven isOdd toStr toFloat` · Float `sqrt floor ceil round abs min max toStr`
- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`
- Time: an app may define `fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]]`; `Sub.every(ms, msg)` (ms >= 50) sends `msg` every `ms` milliseconds while it is listed; `Sub.clock(ms, f)` (ms >= 1000) sends `f(seconds since 1970)`; `Sub.online(f)`/`Sub.visible(f)` send `f(Bool)`.
- UI view: `Html[Msg]` built with `Html.text(s)` `Html.heading(s)` `Html.paragraph(s)` `Html.button(label, msg)` `Html.input(value, f)` `Html.row(kids)` `Html.col(kids)` `Html.node(tag, attrs, kids)`

## What the compiler proves (else it rejects with a code and a counterexample)
Division and `%` need a nonzero divisor; `xs[i]` and `get` need `0 <= i < len`; every call must meet the callee's `requires`; `ensures` and `where` must hold; a recursive function needs `decreases` (an Int that shrinks, or a data value that gets smaller). State what a caller needs in `requires`, what it gets in `ensures`.

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temperature").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("condition").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(40, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Berlin: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temperature\":21,\"condition\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Berlin: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(
    update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temperature\":7,\"condition\":\"fog\"}"))),
    Got(parsed("[]"))
  ).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

# Tez in one page
Pure, typed, verified. No null, exceptions, loops, mutation, classes. Names: `lowerCamel` values, `UpperCamel` types. 2-space indent, no `;`.

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`
```
type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)
type Pos = Int where it > 0
```

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```
Generic: `fn first[T](xs: List[T]) -> Option[T]`.

## Expressions
- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`
There are no loops. Before writing recursion over a list, use these methods: `xs.map(f)`, `xs.filter(f)`, `xs.sum()`, `xs.count(f)`, `xs.fold(init, f)`. A method call needs no `decreases`.
- Int `abs min max clamp pow isEven isOdd toStr toFloat` · Float `sqrt floor ceil round abs min max toStr`
- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`
- Time: an app may define `fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]]`; `Sub.every(ms, msg)` (ms >= 50) sends `msg` every `ms` milliseconds while it is listed; `Sub.clock(ms, f)` (ms >= 1000) sends `f(seconds since 1970)`; `Sub.online(f)`/`Sub.visible(f)` send `f(Bool)`.
- UI view: `Html[Msg]` built with `Html.text(s)` `Html.heading(s)` `Html.paragraph(s)` `Html.button(label, msg)` `Html.input(value, f)` `Html.row(kids)` `Html.col(kids)` `Html.node(tag, attrs, kids)`

Division and `%` need a nonzero divisor; `xs[i]` and `get` need `0 <= i < len`; every call must meet the callee's `requires`; `ensures` and `where` must hold; a recursive function needs `decreases` (an Int that shrinks, or a data value that gets smaller).   Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h

fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi

A weather card for Cairo: it loads weather.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "celsius" in degrees Celsius and a text "sky"), shows "Cairo: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 5 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("celsius").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("sky").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("weather.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(300000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Cairo: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"celsius\":21,\"sky\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Cairo: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"celsius\":7,\"sky\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("weather.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(600000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Berlin: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

A weather card for Lima: it loads forecast.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "temp" in degrees Celsius and a text "summary"), shows "Lima: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 15 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

Write it as a Tez app with init, update and view. Reply with Tez code only.

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(900000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lima: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temp\":21,\"summary\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Lima: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temp\":7,\"summary\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }

  requires n >= 0
  decreases n

- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)

- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`

```
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temperature").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("condition").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(1800000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lima: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.title("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

  Err(e) => JNull
}

    Got(parsed("[]"))

fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }

A weather card for Tokyo: it loads conditions.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "temp" in degrees Celsius and a text "summary"), shows "Tokyo: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 10 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("conditions.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(600000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Tokyo: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temp\":21,\"summary\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Tokyo: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temp\":7,\"summary\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0 }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(900000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lima: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1

type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(600000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Oslo: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.title("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),

  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temp\":7,\"summary\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

  Rect(w, h) => w * h

  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi

  decreases n

- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)

- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`

- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`

Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(300000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lima: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temp\":21,\"summary\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Lima: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temp\":7,\"summary\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("conditions.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(900000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lima: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}

fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }

  decreases n

A weather card for Cairo: it loads weather.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "celsius" in degrees Celsius and a text "sky"), shows "Cairo: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 5 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("celsius").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("sky").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("weather.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(300000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Cairo: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"celsius\":21,\"sky\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Cairo: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"celsius\":7,\"sky\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }

- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)

- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`

Pure, typed, verified. No null, exceptions, loops, mutation, classes. Names: `lowerCamel` values, `UpperCamel` types. 2-space indent, no `;`.

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`

```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }

- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)

- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`

# Tez in one page
Pure, typed, verified. No null, exceptions, loops, mutation, classes. Names: `lowerCamel` values, `UpperCamel` types. 2-space indent, no `;`.

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`
```
type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)
type Pos = Int where it > 0
```

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```
Generic: `fn first[T](xs: List[T]) -> Option[T]`.

## Expressions
- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`
There are no loops. Before writing recursion over a list, use these methods: `xs.map(f)`, `xs.filter(f)`, `xs.sum()`, `xs.count(f)`, `xs.fold(init, f)`. A method call needs no `decreases`.
- Int `abs min max clamp pow isEven isOdd toStr toFloat` · Float `sqrt floor ceil round abs min max toStr`
- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`
- Time: an app may define `fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]]`; `Sub.every(ms, msg)` (ms >= 50) sends `msg` every `ms` milliseconds while it is listed; `Sub.clock(ms, f)` (ms >= 1000) sends `f(seconds since 1970)`; `Sub.online(f)`/`Sub.visible(f)` send `f(Bool)`.

# Tez in one page
Pure, typed, verified. No null, exceptions, loops, mutation, classes. Names: `lowerCamel` values, `UpperCamel` types. 2-space indent, no `;`.

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`
```
type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)
type Pos = Int where it > 0
```

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```
Generic: `fn first[T](xs: List[T]) -> Option[T]`.

## Expressions
- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`
There are no loops. Before writing recursion over a list, use these methods: `xs.map(f)`, `xs.filter(f)`, `xs.sum()`, `xs.count(f)`, `xs.fold(init, f)`. A method call needs no `decreases`.
- Int `abs min max clamp pow isEven isOdd toStr toFloat` · Float `sqrt floor ceil round abs min max toStr`
- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`
- Time: an app may define `fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]]`; `Sub.every(ms, msg)` (ms >= 50) sends `msg` every `ms` milliseconds while it is listed; `Sub.clock(ms, f)` (ms >= 1000) sends `f(seconds since 1970)`; `Sub.online(f)`/`Sub.visible(f)` send `f(Bool)`.
- UI view: `Html[Msg]` built with `Html.text(s)` `Html.heading(s)` `Html.paragraph(s)` `Html.button(label, msg)` `Html.input(value, f)` `Html.row(kids)` `Html.col(kids)` `Html.node(tag, attrs, kids)`

## What the compiler proves (else it rejects with a code and a counterexample)

A weather card for Lima: it loads forecast.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "temp" in degrees Celsius and a text "summary"), shows "Lima: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 5 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

Write it as a Tez app with init, update and view. Reply with Tez code only.

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(300000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lima: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temp\":21,\"summary\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Lima: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temp\":7,\"summary\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,

}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("weather.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(1800000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lima: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

  Err(e) => JNull

A weather card for Oslo: it loads forecast.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "temp" in degrees Celsius and a text "summary"), shows "Oslo: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 10 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(600000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Oslo: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temp\":21,\"summary\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Oslo: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temp\":7,\"summary\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`

type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)
type Pos = Int where it > 0
```

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }

- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`

type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```

- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temperature").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("condition").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

    " UTC)"

A weather card for Oslo: it loads weather.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "temp" in degrees Celsius and a text "summary"), shows "Oslo: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 30 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("weather.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(1800000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Oslo: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temp\":21,\"summary\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Oslo: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temp\":7,\"summary\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("conditions.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(300000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lima: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"temp\":21,\"summary\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Lima: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"temp\":7,\"summary\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temperature").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("condition").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }

  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(300000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {

    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++

    " UTC)"

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("temp").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("summary").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("conditions.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(300000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Cairo: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`

type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n

- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)

- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`

Pure, typed, verified. No null, exceptions, loops, mutation, classes. Names: `lowerCamel` values, `UpperCamel` types. 2-space indent, no `;`.

## Types
`Int` (unbounded) `Float` `Bool` `Str` `()` `List[T]` `(A, B)` `(A) -> B` `Option[T]`=`None|Some(T)` `Result[T,E]`=`Ok(T)|Err(E)`
```
type Point = { x: Int, y: Int }
type Shape = Circle(Int) | Rect(Int, Int)
type Pos = Int where it > 0
```

## Functions: signature always written; body is one expression after `=`
```
fn area(s: Shape) -> Int = match s {
  Circle(r) => 3 * r * r
  Rect(w, h) => w * h
}
fn div(a: Int, b: Int where it != 0) -> Int = a / b
fn avg(xs: List[Int]) -> Int
  requires xs.len() > 0
  = xs.sum() / xs.len()
fn clamp(x: Int, lo: Int, hi: Int) -> Int
  requires lo <= hi
  ensures lo <= result && result <= hi
  = if x < lo { lo } else if x > hi { hi } else { x }
fn fact(n: Int) -> Int
  requires n >= 0
  decreases n
  = if n == 0 { 1 } else { n * fact(n - 1) }
```
Generic: `fn first[T](xs: List[T]) -> Option[T]`.

## Expressions
- `if c { a } else { b }` (else required) · `match e { pat => v }` one arm per line, no commas
- block: `{ let y = f(x) \n assert y > 0 \n y + 1 }` (last line is the value)
- `Point { x: 1, y: 2 }` · `p with { x: 3 }` · `p.x` · `t.0` · `xs[i]` · `[1, 2]` · `(a, b)`
- lambda `x => x + 1`, `(a, b) => a + b`, `_ => 0`
- `a ++ b` joins Str · `&&` and `||` need parentheses when mixed · comparisons do not chain
- `/` and `%` truncate toward zero · patterns: `_` `n` `0` `Some(x)` `(a, b)` `[]` `[h, ..t]`, guard `n if n > 0`

- Several files: `use "other.tez"` at the top of every file that uses its names.

## Methods: always `value.method(args)`, never `List.map(xs, f)`
There are no loops. Before writing recursion over a list, use these methods: `xs.map(f)`, `xs.filter(f)`, `xs.sum()`, `xs.count(f)`, `xs.fold(init, f)`. A method call needs no `decreases`.
- Int `abs min max clamp pow isEven isOdd toStr toFloat` · Float `sqrt floor ceil round abs min max toStr`
- Str `len slice chars toInt contains startsWith endsWith trim upper lower split repeat replace isEmpty`
- List `len get map filter fold flatMap append concat reverse take drop any all count contains indexOf first last zip enumerate sort sortBy sum min max join isEmpty` · static `List.range(lo, hi)` `List.repeat(x, n)`
- Option `isSome isNone unwrapOr map andThen` · Result `isOk unwrapOr map mapErr toOption`
- Time: an app may define `fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]]`; `Sub.every(ms, msg)` (ms >= 50) sends `msg` every `ms` milliseconds while it is listed; `Sub.clock(ms, f)` (ms >= 1000) sends `f(seconds since 1970)`; `Sub.online(f)`/`Sub.visible(f)` send `f(Bool)`.

  Got(j) =>

      text: j.get("sky").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),

Make a small interactive web page in Tez. A weather card for Lisbon: it loads forecast.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "celsius" in degrees Celsius and a text "sky"), shows "Lisbon: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 30 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("celsius").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("sky").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("forecast.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(1800000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Lisbon: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"celsius\":21,\"sky\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Lisbon: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"celsius\":7,\"sky\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```

A weather card for Cairo: it loads weather.json from this site (a JSON object with a whole-number "celsius" in degrees Celsius and a text "sky"), shows "Cairo: <temp> °C, <text>" and the time of the last update as HH:MM UTC, and refreshes every 10 minutes by itself. Before the first answer it says "Loading...".

```tez
type Model = {
  round: Int where it >= 0,
  now: Int,
  temp: Int,
  text: Str,
  updatedAt: Int,
  loaded: Bool
}

type Msg = Got(Json) | Failed(Str) | Tick(Int) | Again

fn init() -> Model = Model { round: 0, now: 0, temp: 0, text: "", updatedAt: 0, loaded: false }

fn update(m: Model, msg: Msg) -> Model = match msg {
  Got(j) =>
    Model {
      round: m.round,
      now: m.now,
      temp: j.get("celsius").andThen(t => t.int()).unwrapOr(m.temp),
      text: j.get("sky").andThen(t => t.str()).unwrapOr(m.text),
      updatedAt: m.now,
      loaded: true
    }
  Failed(e) => m
  Tick(t) => m with { now: t }
  Again => m with { round: m.round + 1 }
}

fn fetches(m: Model) -> List[Fetch[Msg]] =
  [Fetch.json("weather.json?round=" ++ m.round.toStr(), j => Got(j), e => Failed(e))]

fn subs(m: Model) -> List[Sub[Msg]] = [Sub.clock(1000, t => Tick(t)), Sub.every(600000, Again)]

fn summary(m: Model) -> Str = if !m.loaded { "Loading..." } else {
  "Cairo: " ++
    m.temp.toStr() ++
    " °C, " ++
    m.text ++
    " (updated " ++
    Time.hhmm(m.updatedAt) ++
    " UTC)"
}

fn view(m: Model) -> Html[Msg] = Html.col([Html.heading("Weather"), Html.paragraph(summary(m))])

fn parsed(text: Str) -> Json = match Json.parse(text) {
  Ok(j) => j
  Err(e) => JNull
}

test startsLoading = summary(init()) == "Loading..."

test showsTheReading =
  summary(
    update(
      update(init(), Tick(3600 * 9 + 60 * 30)),
      Got(parsed("{\"celsius\":21,\"sky\":\"clear\"}"))
    )
  ) ==
    "Cairo: 21 °C, clear (updated 09:30 UTC)"

test aBrokenAnswerKeepsTheOldReading =
  update(update(init(), Got(parsed("{\"celsius\":7,\"sky\":\"fog\"}"))), Got(parsed("[]"))).temp ==
    7

test failureChangesNothing = update(init(), Failed("HTTP 500")) == init()

test refreshesOnASchedule = subs(init()).len() == 2 && fetches(update(init(), Again)).len() == 1
```
